subject: stats: use an alternative function to read the bound from `BLOB` stored in `mysql.stats_buckets`. (#59791)
summary: Reviewed the first-parent diff for stats bucket bound encoding/decoding. The change fixes BIT histogram bucket bound loading by parsing the decimal-text representation stored in `mysql.stats_buckets` BLOBs (previously mis-decoded as raw bytes via `Datum.ConvertTo(mysql.TypeBit)`), and adds a regression test covering multiple BIT lengths/inputs; no remaining Blocker/High correctness, consistency, compatibility, or session/txn issues found in the touched statistics read/write paths.
